job.job_description:
AI & Generative AI Development
Design, build, and deploy AI/GenAI-powered enterprise solutions.
Develop AI agents, agentic workflows, and automation pipelines.
Implement Prompt Engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and AI orchestration frameworks.
Create guardrails, validation mechanisms, and human-in-the-loop review processes to ensure responsible AI adoption.
Optimize AI solution performance, accuracy, and reliability.
Application Modernization
Support legacy modernization and transformation programs using AI-driven approaches.
Leverage AI for:
Code comprehension
Reverse engineering
Business rule extraction
Dependency mapping
Documentation generation
Test generation and automation
Code migration and modernization acceleration
Work with legacy technologies such as HP NonStop, COBOL, C++, batch processing, or similar platforms.
Software Engineering & Cloud Development
Develop and maintain enterprise applications using .NET/C#, ASP.NET, and Web APIs.
Build AI-enhanced applications and services integrated with existing enterprise systems.
Develop automation solutions using Python and AI frameworks.
Work with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, cloud-native services, and modern engineering platforms.
Collaborate on API integrations, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps initiatives.
